title: goswamia raphaeliana
intro: Goswamia raphaeliana, commonly known as the "Indian ginseng" or "Rauwolfia", is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. It is an evergreen shrub used in traditional medicine, valued for its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Goswamia raphaeliana include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
